title: The verb to be: am, is, are
explanation: Use 'am' with I, 'is' with he, she and it, and 'are' with you, we and they.

exercises.promptSo: Buuxi meesha bannaan adigoo dooranaya ama qoraya qaabka falka ee saxda ah.
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabtani waxay raacaysaa xeerka casharkan: Fal-falka “to be” waxaa loo adeegsadaa in lagu sheego qof ama shay waxa uu yahay, meesha uu joogo ama xaaladdiisa. “I” waxaa raaca “am”; “he”, “she” iyo “it” waxaa raaca “is”; “you”, “we” iyo “they” waxaa raaca “are”.

exercises.promptSo: Dooro jawaabta saxda ah si jumladda Ingiriisigu u noqoto mid naxwe ahaan sax ah.

title: Articles: a and an
explanation: Use 'an' before a vowel sound and 'a' before a consonant sound. It is the sound that matters, not the spelling.
examples: a university (it starts with a 'y' sound)

exercises.explain: Orange starts with a vowel sound.
exercises.promptSo: Dooro jawaabta saxda ah si jumladda Ingiriisigu u noqoto mid naxwe ahaan sax ah.
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabtani waxay raacaysaa xeerka casharkan: “A” iyo “an” waa erayo magac-u-horreeya oo lagu isticmaalo magac keli ah oo aan weli si gaar ah loo cayimin. “An” waxaa la adeegsadaa marka dhawaaqa ugu horreeya uu yahay shaqal; “a” marka uu yahay shibbane. Waxa muhiimka ahi waa dhawaaqa, ma aha xarafka qoraalka.

title: Present perfect and past simple
explanation: Use the present perfect (have/has + past participle) for experiences or situations that connect to now. Use the past simple for finished times, such as 'in 2019' or 'yesterday'.
examples: She has lived here for five years.

exercises.explain: 'In 2018' is a finished time, so use the past simple.
exercises.promptSo: Dooro jawaabta saxda ah si jumladda Ingiriisigu u noqoto mid naxwe ahaan sax ah.
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabtani waxay raacaysaa xeerka casharkan: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) waxaa loo adeegsadaa waayo-aragnimo ama xaalad hore u bilaabatay oo xidhiidh la leh waqtiga hadda. Past Simple waxaa loo adeegsadaa dhacdo dhammaatay oo wakhtigeeda la cayimay, sida “yesterday” ama “in 2019”.

exercises.explain: 'Never eaten' is present perfect: have + eaten.
exercises.promptSo: Dooro jawaabta saxda ah si jumladda Ingiriisigu u noqoto mid naxwe ahaan sax ah.
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabtani waxay raacaysaa xeerka casharkan: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) waxaa loo adeegsadaa waayo-aragnimo ama xaalad hore u bilaabatay oo xidhiidh la leh waqtiga hadda. Past Simple waxaa loo adeegsadaa dhacdo dhammaatay oo wakhtigeeda la cayimay, sida “yesterday” ama “in 2019”.

exercises.explain: 'Since 2020' links the past to now, so use has + lived.

exercises.explainSo: Jawaabtani waxay raacaysaa xeerka casharkan: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) waxaa loo adeegsadaa waayo-aragnimo ama xaalad hore u bilaabatay oo xidhiidh la leh waqtiga hadda. Past Simple waxaa loo adeegsadaa dhacdo dhammaatay oo wakhtigeeda la cayimay, sida “yesterday” ama “in 2019”.

explanationSo: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) waxaa loo adeegsadaa waayo-aragnimo ama xaalad hore u bilaabatay oo xidhiidh la leh waqtiga hadda. Past Simple waxaa loo adeegsadaa dhacdo dhammaatay oo wakhtigeeda la cayimay, sida “yesterday” ama “in 2019”.
examplesSo: I have visited Nairobi. = Waxaan booqday Nayroobi (waayo-aragnimo).
I visited Nairobi in 2019. = Waxaan Nayroobi booqday sannadkii 2019.
